insight: transformers 5.x changed CLIPModel.get_text_features/get_image_features to return a BaseModelOutputWithPooling (dict-like) instead of a tensor, so .norm() embedding normalization raises AttributeError and breaks CLIP search/indexing. Pin transformers<5.0.0 for CLIP code written against the 4.x API.

pytest run as the console script (pytest tests/) does NOT prepend CWD to sys.path, so top-level package imports (import common) fail in CI even though python -m pytest works locally. Fix: pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] pythonpath=["."]. Verify CI-style with .venv/bin/pytest (console script), not just python -m pytest.
